name: bambara-speech-recognition-benchmark
description: A speech recognition dataset for the Bambara language providing audio recordings paired with transcriptions to evaluate automatic speech recognition systems on a low-resource West African language. The benchmark measures ASR performance (robustness to accents, noise, and limited training data) and supports development of transcription models for underrepresented languages. It is intended for training and evaluating end-to-end ASR and transcription pipelines.
reputation: A niche, low-resource-language ASR dataset hosted on Hugging Face; useful for researchers working on underrepresented languages but with limited broad adoption.
